title: Glowing drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd07a' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd07a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='48' ry='44' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- drum body -->
  <rect x='24' y='34' width='52' height='42' rx='6' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- body lighter left shade -->
  <rect x='24' y='34' width='14' height='42' rx='6' fill='#e05a4a'/>
  <!-- body lighter right shade -->
  <rect x='62' y='34' width='14' height='42' rx='6' fill='#a8302a'/>
  <!-- bottom rim -->
  <rect x='22' y='68' width='56' height='8' rx='4' fill='#f5c518'/>
  <rect x='22' y='68' width='56' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <!-- top rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='28' ry='9' fill='#f5c518'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='24' ry='7' fill='#fff2b8'/>
  <!-- drum head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='20' ry='5.5' fill='#fdf6e3'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33.5' rx='13' ry='3.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- tension lugs -->
  <rect x='31' y='44' width='4' height='18' rx='2' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <rect x='65' y='44' width='4' height='18' rx='2' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <!-- glowing sparkles -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='25' r='1.6' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='22' r='1.2' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='22' r='1.2' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='1' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <!-- drumstick crossing -->
  <rect x='66' y='16' width='4' height='26' rx='2' fill='#d9a066' transform='rotate(25 68 29)'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='14' r='3' fill='#f0c27a'/>
</svg>
